notes: 404 not_found for a file in a folder the caller doesn't see. GET /api/files/{id}/content sends the file as uploaded, with Content-Disposition attachment and ETag "<id>"; it answers Range and If-Range (206), and nothing may cache it. GET /api/files/{id}/thumb is a JPEG of up to 512 pixels, 404 if there is none; updated_at changes with it.
